description: Source code for a tool that performs batch comparisons of certificate verification results between platform and builtin verifiers, primarily used on Windows, involving network setup, certificate verification, and proto file parsing.

classes.name: CertVerifyImpl
classes.description: Encapsulates certificate verification using a specific CertVerifyProc implementation, providing verification functionality.

methods.name: VerifyCert
methods.description: Performs certificate verification for a given certificate and hostname, returning success status.

methods.name: CreateCertVerifyImplFromName
methods.description: Factory function to create a CertVerifyImpl based on implementation name ('platform' or 'builtin').

methods.name: PrintStats
methods.description: Outputs collected statistics about file processing and chain comparisons.

methods.name: TrialComparisonResultToString
methods.description: Converts a net::TrialComparisonResult enum value to a string for display.

methods.name: PrintUsage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the tool.

methods.name: RunCert
methods.description: Reads and processes a single certificate chain proto from input file, performs verification comparisons, and outputs differences.
